# Prime Tree Care

> Prime Tree Care is an ISA-certified tree care company serving Chicago, IL and the surrounding suburbs (Cook, DuPage, and Kane counties). Services include tree removal, tree trimming and pruning, tree health inspection and disease treatment, Emerald Ash Borer (EAB) evaluation, stump grinding, storm prep and tree support systems, tree and shrub fertilization, tree planting and transplanting, and 24/7 emergency tree service. The company is based at 8811 W 87th St, Hickory Hills, IL 60457 and is led by founder and lead arborist David Kowalski.

## Company

- [Home](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/): Overview of Prime Tree Care's services, service area, and why homeowners choose ISA-certified arborists.

## Services

- [All Services](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/): Full list of tree care services offered across Chicagoland.
- [Tree Removal](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/tree-removal): Safe removal of hazardous, dead, diseased, and difficult-access trees.
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/tree-trimming-pruning): Structural pruning, deadwood removal, canopy balancing, and dormant-season pruning.
- [Tree Health Inspection & Treatment](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/tree-health-inspection-treatment): ISA-certified inspections diagnosing Emerald Ash Borer, disease, and canopy decline, with treatment planning.
- [Emergency Tree Removal](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/emergency-tree-removal): 24/7 emergency response for storm damage, fallen limbs, and leaning trees.
- [Stump Grinding](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/stump-grinding): Below-grade stump removal for landscape restoration and replanting.
- [Storm Prep & Tree Support Systems](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/storm-prep-tree-support-systems): Cabling, bracing, and structural reinforcement ahead of severe weather.
- [Tree & Shrub Fertilization](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/tree-shrub-fertilization): Soil-specific fertilization programs for Chicago's clay-heavy soil conditions.
- [Tree Planting & Transplanting](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/services/tree-planting-transplanting): Species selection, planting, and transplanting services.

- [Do I Need a Permit to Remove a Tree in Chicago?](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/do-i-need-a-permit-to-remove-a-tree-in-chicago): Permit requirements for private and parkway tree removal in Chicago.
- [Hazardous City Trees: What to Do](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/hazardous-city-tree-chicago-what-to-do): Steps to take when a parkway or city-owned tree becomes a hazard.
- [Parkway Trees vs. Private Trees in Chicago](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/parkway-trees-vs-private-trees-chicago): Ownership and maintenance responsibility differences.
- [Silver Maple Problems in Chicago](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/silver-maple-problems-chicago): Structural weaknesses and storm risk common to silver maples.
- [Stump Grinding Cost in Chicago](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/stump-grinding-cost-chicago): Factors that affect stump grinding pricing.
- [Tree Law & Neighbor Disputes in Chicago](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/tree-law-chicago-neighbor-disputes): Legal basics for tree disputes between neighboring properties.
- [What to Plant Instead of Ash in Chicago](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/what-to-plant-instead-of-ash-chicago): Replacement species recommendations after EAB losses.
- [Why the Cheapest Tree Quote Is Risky](https://primetreecare.pages.dev/blog/why-the-cheapest-tree-quote-is-risky): What low-ball tree service quotes often leave out.
